text:
alex: Morning — quick rollcall for BridgeWave kernel work. Blocking items: PR #4828 (kv-prefetch handshake), perf test failing on long-seq. Who owns the PR review?

maya: I own the handshake PR, but was waiting on infra tag. I can review today, ~11:30 PT.

ben: I can pick up the perf-test flake — seeing OOM in microbatch path. Sharing logs: ```OOM at kernel.cc:214 batch=64 seq=8192```

sam: Infra bumped image to rdx-runtime:v2026-03. Ben, can you re-run canary? I kicked a job: https://ci.redwood/1234

alex: thx. Also Q on ownership for KV cache eviction heuristic — is that still with maya or moved to caching squad?

maya: caching squad (ben) owns heuristics now. I'll hand off the PR to @ben and remove the stale TODO in the description.

ben: ack. I'll add a comment and an experimental fallback flag: `--kv-evict-threshold=0.75` (default for canary). Planning to run microbatch with batch=32 seq=4096 to repro.

ops-bot: deploy-started bridgewave-canary → node-group: canary-3, image: rdx-runtime:v2026-03

alex: perf test rerun scheduled at 11:40 PT. If tests pass, plan to merge canary after 30m of smoke. anyone object?

sam: no objections. I'll monitor latency dashboards (p50/p95) and alert if p95 > 180ms.

maya: I'll follow up on review comments after lunch. :thumbsup:

ben: update: reproed OOM locally, pushing small GC fix to PR and will re-run CI.

alex: great — ping here when CI green and you merge. Thanks everyone.
